alibaba.selection: First nonempty container ID c_1; first 42 observations in timestamp order. All 1018 c_1 rows read before selecting.
alibaba.transformation_caveat: CPU telemetry converted to relative HTTP demand, not original application requests. Irregular observation intervals are mapped to equal 10-second replay bins; no interpolation. One container is not representative of the whole Alibaba cluster.
alibaba.prefix_caveat: HTTP 206 ranged prefix, not a complete gzip archive; no full-archive CRC verification. Complete c_1 records end before prefix truncation.
